title: How do I add an athlete to augo?
seoTitle: Adding an Athlete to augo: Invite Link and Code | augo support
description: Copy your invite from the Athletes panel and share it. Athletes join by tapping the link or entering your coach code in the app.
summary: In the web app, open Athletes, click ADD, then Copy invite. Share the message it gives you. Your athlete downloads the augo app, creates an account, and either taps your invite link or enters your coach code manually to connect with you.

body.html: Athletes join your roster through an invite you generate and share. There is nothing to fill in on your side — no email address, no account setup on their behalf. You copy one message and send it however you already talk to them.

steps.title: Open Athletes and click ADD
steps.html: In the web app, open the Athletes panel and click ADD in the top right.

media.alt: The augo web app with the Athletes panel open and the ADD button highlighted in the top right of the panel
media.caption: Athletes → ADD.

steps.title: Copy your invite
steps.html: The Grow your athlete base window opens. Click Copy invite to put the whole invitation message on your clipboard.

media.alt: The Grow your athlete base window with a Copy invite button
media.caption: One button copies the full message, link and code together.

steps.title: Send it to your athlete
steps.html:
Paste it wherever you already talk to them — WhatsApp, email, a DM. The copied message looks like this, with your own code filled in:

Hey! I’m inviting you to join me on augo.

Step 1 — Download the app:
https://augotraining.com/en/download

Step 2 — Tap this link to connect with me:
https://app.augotraining.com/join-coach?code=YOURCODE

Alternatively, open the app and enter this code manually:
YOURCODE

The same invite works for every athlete you send it to, so you can reuse it rather than generating a new one each time.

body.html:
What your athlete does

Two routes, and both end in the same place. If they already have the app, they can skip straight to the second.

  • Tap the link. It opens app.augotraining.com/join-coach with your code already attached and connects them to you.
  • Enter the code manually. If the link doesn’t open properly — an in-app browser, a stripped link, a forwarded message — they can open augo and type the code in by hand. Same result.

If they don’t have augo yet, step 1 of the message points them at the download page to install it and create an account first.

After they join

They appear on your roster straight away, but their training feed stays empty until they connect a data source. That step is theirs to do from their own account — you can’t do it for them. See which devices and apps augo syncs with.

This is the single most common reason a newly added athlete looks broken. They’ve joined; they just haven’t linked their watch.

faqs.question: Where do I find my invite link?
faqs.answer: In the web app, open the Athletes panel, click ADD, then Copy invite. That copies the full message including your link and your coach code.

faqs.question: Can I use the same invite for more than one athlete?
faqs.answer: Yes. The invite is yours rather than per-athlete, so you can send the same message to everyone you want to add.

faqs.question: My athlete tapped the link and nothing happened. What now?
faqs.answer: Ask them to open the augo app and enter the coach code manually instead. The invite message includes the code for exactly this case — links can get stripped or opened in an in-app browser that cannot hand off to the app.

faqs.question: Why is my new athlete’s training feed empty?
faqs.answer: Almost always because they have joined but not yet connected a data source. The athlete has to link Garmin, Polar, Strava, Coros, Wahoo or Zwift from their own account — a coach cannot do it for them.
